definitions.full: H4562. masoreth מָסֹ֫רֶת noun feminine construct ׳מ הַבְּרִית bond of the covenant Ezek 20:37 (= מַאֲסֹרֶת ; text dubious compare Lag GN 1882, 168 f. M 61; Co reads מוסר , i.e. מוּסָר see below יסר ; so ᵑ6 ). [ מוֺסֵר ] noun masculine Isa 28:22 band, bond , in poetry & late (= מֹאסֵר ; Ethiopic Syriac , compare Assyrian mêsiru , sheathing , plating , e.g. Lyon Sargontexte, p. 16, l. 65 & p. 80 ) — construct מוֺסַר Job 12:18 (so Di Hoffm and others for מוּסַר ); plural מוֺסֵרוֺת Jer 5:5 ; 27:2 ; construct מֹסְרוֺת Job 39:5 ; מוֺסְרֵי Isa 52:2 ; suffix מוֺסֵרָי֑ Psa 116:16 ; מוֺסְרוֺתֶיךָ Jer 30:8 ; מוֺסְרֵיכֶם Isa 28:22 ; מוֺסְרוֺתֵי֑מוֺ Psa 2:3 etc.; — bands accusative after פִתֵּהַ Job 39:5 restraining-bands of wild ass; Psa 116:16 bonds of distress; Isa 52:2 ׳מ צַוָּארֵח bonds of captivity of Zion, verb Hithpa`el; compare also Job 12:18 מִּתֵּחַ מְלָכִים מוֺסַר (so read, see above & AV RV); Di understands bonds imposed by kings; Hoffm girdles of kings, & reads וַיָּסַר in ||, for וַיֶּאְסַר ; more often accusative after נִתֵּק Psa 2:3 bonds imposed by ׳י & his anointed, compare Jer 5:5 & 2:20 ( ᵑ9 ᵐ5 , see Commentaries); of Yahweh's breaking bonds of Israel 30:8 ; Nahum 1:13 (last four || עֹל שָׁבַר ), bonds of oppressed Psa 107:14 ; מ ׳יֶחְזְקוּ Isa 28:22 , i.e. bonds imposed by Assyria; compare Jer 27:2 (|| מֹט ) literal, symbolic of rule of Nebuchadrezzar.
